title: UI/UX Designer
description: A practical design roadmap covering research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, and portfolio case studies.

tree.name: UX Foundations
tree.description: Understand users, problems, constraints, journeys, usability, and how design decisions affect outcomes.

resources.title: UI/UX Design Tutorial - Wireframe, Mockup & Design in Figma (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: User Research
children.description: Plan interviews, surveys, competitive analysis, personas, and journey maps without inventing user needs.

children.name: Information Architecture
children.description: Structure navigation, labels, content hierarchy, user flows, and task paths.

tree.name: UI and Visual Design
tree.description: Learn layout, spacing, typography, color, component states, responsive design, and design critique.

children.name: Typography and Layout
children.description: Use readable type scales, grids, alignment, rhythm, contrast, and content-first layouts.

children.name: Accessibility
children.description: Design for keyboard use, labels, contrast, readable content, focus states, and inclusive patterns.

children.name: Practice: Usability Critique Sprint
children.description: Review a real app flow, identify usability issues, propose design changes, and validate with lightweight tests.

tree.name: Figma and Design Systems
tree.description: Use Figma professionally with components, variants, auto layout, prototypes, libraries, and handoff.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Components and Variants
children.description: Create reusable, documented UI components with states, variants, and component properties.

children.name: Design Systems
children.description: Build tokens, components, usage rules, documentation, and governance for product teams.

tree.name: Testing and Portfolio
tree.description: Validate designs, measure usability, and present strong case studies with problem, process, tradeoffs, and results.

children.name: Usability Testing
children.description: Create tasks, observe behavior, synthesize findings, and improve designs based on evidence.

children.name: Design Critique and Developer Handoff
children.description: Present design rationale, respond to critique, prepare specs, annotate states, and support implementation.

children.name: Project: Product Redesign Case Study
children.description: Redesign a real flow, document research, prototype, test, iterate, and publish a concise portfolio story.
